title: H3 Fast Motion control next to Turbo: skip the upscale route
description: Fabio, 2026-10-25 (MPI-1135 Phase 1): on fast motion, the no-upscale path won every time. On low action (Shot D) the upscale looked the same as none. Add a Fast Motion toggle next to Turbo. When on, render at the target size with no stage-1 halving and no 3D latent upscale/refine. 2K and 4K still upscale, but only when the user asks for more than 1080x1920. Graph reference: MPI-1135 step0 build_step0.py 'none' arm.
